summary: Lumen Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the refinancing and amendment of its subsidiary Level 3's existing credit agreement. A wholly owned indirect subsidiary repriced its term loan facility, reducing margins and enabling an administrative agent transition. Post-transaction, $2,400 million remains outstanding with interest at SOFR plus 2.75% or base rate plus 1.75%, no amortization, maturing March 2032. No acquisition, divestiture, shareholder return, or special corporate action is present; this is a ordinary debt-refinancing, not a special situation.
